entries.t: The World of Medabots (1)

Set in the near future, where robots as smart
as people, called Medabots, are everywhere:
a tale of humans and robots living together!
The World of Medabots (2)

Medabots have caught on as toys, and the
sport of pitting them against each other,
the Robattle, is all the rage in this world!
What Is a Medabot? (1)

Medabot is short for Medal Robot: a robot run
by a Medal that holds unknown power. Each has
its own mind and personality, a robot buddy.
What Is a Medabot? (2)

A Medabot is built on a Tinpet frame, fitted
with 4 Medaparts: head, right arm, left arm
and legs, plus a Medal for its brain!
Customizing Your Medabot (1)

Swap parts around and you can customize
your Medabot in countless ways, all your own!
Medabot Motifs (1)

Medabots come in a huge variety of motifs:
insects, animals, plants, mythical beasts,
even jobs and vehicles: endless variety!
What Is a Medal? (1)

Medals are believed to be ancient beings'
souls and memories, sealed in hexagonal metal!
What Is a Medal? (2)

Medals are mostly dug up from ruins, but
most of the ones in circulation today are
high-tech copies, known as clones!
What Is a Robattle? (1)

A match between Medabots is called a Robattle,
and it is usually fought by teams of Medabots!
What Is a Robattle? (2)

Robattle blends robot and battle. It is a
global sport with strict rules and etiquette!
What Is a Robattle? (3)

In a Robattle, wrecking a part puts it out of
action. Wreck the head and the match is yours!
What Is an Action Type?

Action types: Shoot, Melee, Support, Heal, Defense and Set.
Combining them to gain the edge is the thrill of Robattling!
What Is Medaforce? (1)

Medaforce draws out the power sleeping deep
in a Medal: a devastating special attack!
What Is Medaforce? (2)

A Medal learns Medaforce as it grows.
It proves the bond of Medabot and Medafighter!
What Is a Medafighter? (1)

A Medafighter owns a Medabot as a partner and
gives it orders and answers for its care!
What Is a Medafighter? (2)

Not just anyone may handle a Medabot: they are
registered, and owners logged as Medafighters.
What Is a Medafighter? (3)

Medafighter does not mean mere owner. It means
the finest partner, who loves and fights beside their Medabot!
Medabots and Medafighters

A Medabot is a robot buddy with a will of its
own, bonding with its Medafighter and growing together.
Terrain and Leg Types

In a Robattle, how your legs match the terrain
is key. Match well for bonuses and the edge!
What Is Medachange?

Medachange is a transform system only certain
models have. Switch form to swap stats and moves!
